question: Does widening the 2008-control catchment on gen1's own flight lines 133-138 enlarge the set and tighten gen1's datum?

inputs.role: per-mark ties + siting screen, vendor class-2 ground, no geoid shift, no lateral shift
per-mark-per-line ties, restricted to that line's own returns
whole-line straight ground-track fits; used for TARGETING only
the pipeline's own per-swath internal alignment, the thing the marks are tested against

params.name: cover_classes
params.why: ADDITIONAL_GROUND_CONTROL.md section 7.1 / GEN1_OWN_CONTROL_TIE.md section 4: the vegetated classes measure canopy, not datum

params.name: catchment_radius_m
params.why: widened from the previous 500 m purely to MEASURE where the catchment ends; it selects candidates to READ, and the line assignment that decides membership is read off point_source_id, not off this

params.name: geoid_shift_m
params.why: 2008 control is NAVD88(GEOID03) and so is the raw gen1 cloud -- same frame, nothing to convert

params.name: swath_shift_m
params.why: no gen2-derived term in a gen1-against-its-own-control comparison

masks.name: on_lines_133_138
masks.defn: the mark's vendor class-2 ground returns inside the 7.5 m report radius include at least one point_source_id in 133-138

columns.line: point_source_id of the returns the tie was estimated from (unitless id)
columns.n_marks: count of open/urban 2008 control marks carrying that line's ground returns
columns.mean_mm: mean over those marks of tie = surveyed - z_lidar, mm; positive = gen1 reads BELOW the mark
columns.sd_mm: sample sd of tie over those marks (ddof=1)
columns.SE_mm: standard error of the mean of the per-mark ties on that line, sd/sqrt(n_marks), mm
columns.median_mm: median of tie over those marks
columns.km_min: smallest distance from the Elba reference point, km
columns.km_max: largest distance from the Elba reference point, km
columns.R_m: candidate catchment: |cross-track| to the nearest 133-138 centreline
columns.n_cand: count of open/urban control marks inside R_m
columns.n_on_lines: count of those candidates whose ground returns actually include a point_source_id in 133-138
columns.n_tiles: count of distinct gen1 tiles the candidates fall in
columns.n_new_tiles: count of those tiles not already on disk before this run
columns.cls: MnDNR land-cover class label: L1O open terrain, L5U urban (unitless)
columns.km: distance from the Elba reference point (579705.72, 4883677.71), km
columns.d_near_m: |cross-track| to the nearest of the six centrelines
columns.line_proxy: line id assigned by nearest fitted centreline -- the OLD rule (unitless id)
columns.line_psid: line id(s) actually present in the ground returns at the mark -- the NEW rule (unitless id)
columns.n_report: count of ground returns inside the 7.5 m report radius
columns.tie_mm: surveyed - z_lidar at the report radius, that line's returns only
columns.sigma_mm: half the tie spread across the pipeline-scale radii (2.5-10 m)
columns.ladder_mm: full tie spread across the pipeline-scale radii
columns.spread_mm: local p05-p95 of ground z within 5 m -- section 7.1 siting
columns.ctrl_pct: percentile of the surveyed height in that local z distribution
columns.dnr_mm: MnDNR's own Control Z - Surface Z for this mark, mm
columns.cut_mm: the sweep value: marks with ladder_mm <= this are kept, mm
columns.sigma_site_mm: pooled sd of tie about its own line's mean (ANOVA within-line)
columns.sd_all_mm: sd of tie over all kept marks, ignoring line
columns.quantity: name of the statistic stated in this row (unitless label)
columns.value: the value of that statistic, with its unit printed in the cell
columns.note: how that value was obtained (unitless text)
columns.dz_pipeline_mm: the vertical component of corrections_geoid.json per_swath_internal_alignment_dxdydz_m for this line, converted to mm
columns.mark_mean_mm: the mark-derived mean tie for this line, mm
columns.n_kept: count of mark-line ties surviving the cut
columns.n_lines_kept: count of distinct flight lines surviving the cut
columns.mean_mm_kept: mean of tie over the surviving mark-line ties, mm

headline: 18 marks, 6 lines, mean of line means +55.0 +/- 16.6 mm; widening the catchment from 500 m to 2000 m added 0 marks
